AI journaling/reflection platform: logs your week, surfaces patterns in mood, energy and goals.
## Demo
`python app.py` analyzes entries.txt and prints mood trend + suggestions.
## Next
Custom check-in questions (Marcus feedback): user-defined prompts per journal.

Procfile included; stdlib only, reads PORT. Works on Render/Railway/Fly as-is.
